caffeine.hint: Keeps the screen on and unlocked.
caffeine.title: Caffeine

layout.apply_failed: Hyprland did not take the layout.
layout.hint: Drag a screen onto an edge of another to put it there.
layout.reset_tooltip: Forget the layout of these screens; Hyprland's own settings apply again

night.dark_mode_note: Noctalia's automatic dark mode follows these times too.
night.no_place: From sunset to sunrise. Set your location in Noctalia's settings, under Location.
night.title: Night light

panel.shared_dim: Dimming below the lowest brightness applies to all screens at once.
panel.title: Screen Control

dim_method.description: How the screens get darker below their lowest brightness. Gamma needs hyprsunset on Hyprland; elsewhere a black layer is used.
dim_method.label: Dimming method

keep_seconds.description: How long Keep this layout? waits before it puts the screens back, in seconds.
keep_seconds.label: Time to keep a layout

max_dim.description: How dark the screens can get below their lowest brightness, in percent.
max_dim.label: Darkest dimming

per_workspace.description: Each workspace keeps its own dimming. Needs Hyprland.
per_workspace.label: Dim each workspace on its own

skip_monitors.description: Monitors to leave out, by connector, such as HDMI-A-1, or part of their name, such as Legion. Use it for a monitor whose brightness control misbehaves.
skip_monitors.label: Leave out monitors

step_dims.description: Scrolling on the widget and the brightness keys go on past the lowest brightness into extra dim. Off, they stop there, and extra dim has its own slider in the panel.
step_dims.label: Scroll into extra dim
